text_post: Case study: Bob Dylan.  By age 26 he'd written a hundred plus songs, revolutionised popular music, fallen in love a few times, banged probably a thousand groupies, and was the coolest guy on the planet. At which point, he basically went into exile, didn't perform for almost a decade, got married and voluntarily cucked himself with kids. When approached by Scorsese to make a documentary about his life in the 2000s, he said he wanted it to focus only on that (pre-27) period. Nothing after that. Because nothing after that matters. He lived an exaggerated version of the average femoid and the top 20% of guys. @ 25 he was a God, @ 35 he was a sad old man who had produced 90% of his best music and turned to God cope.  https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=pyQw-AFRIZU
